kaibel.evidence: Manual scan inspection: the volume is Kaibel's Comicorum Graecorum Fragmenta I.1 (1899); printed page 42, scan 65, contains Tzetzes' Iambi technici, including verse 86. Both supposed author files contain this page and sections headed Epicharmus and Sophron. They are overlapping OCR witnesses of the anthology, not the collected fragments of either named author. Preserve both witnesses under a collective volume identity; do not infer author boundaries from drifting OCR page keys.
